description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer for one of our PRIME CONTRACTS and offers exciting opportunities to support essential services and mission critical activities across the enterprise. Our mission supports the Government Corporate Management Services (CMS) by providing full life cycle support services through the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of the enterprise corporate applications. These applications are used across the government enterprise and are critical to the daily functions of thousands of users across acquisition, business, finance, HR, training, recruitment, program management, security, logistics and more. Come join our diverse and growing team with lots of opportunities! 

 We are seeking a Software Engineer t o support a diverse portfolio of enterprise applications delivering mission-critical capabilities across Infrastructure & Logistics (I&L). The selected candidate will play a key role supporting multiple Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) applications that enable enterprise business functions including asset management, facilities, transportation, and other corporate services.   

 This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across multiple technologies and technical disciplines. The selected candidate will support a diverse portfolio of Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) enterprise applications utilizing both modern and legacy technology stacks. Responsibilities may include application development, system integration, application configuration and customization, cloud modernization, and production sustainment. Success in this role requires adaptability, strong technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to quickly learn new technologies as mission priorities evolve.   

 The ideal candidate is a versatile software developer with experience building and supporting enterprise applications. You should be comfortable working with Java, JavaScript, Oracle databases, and SQL, and have the aptitude and willingness to learn additional programming languages, frameworks, and technologies based on the needs of the products and applications you support.   

 Primary Responsibilities:   

 
 Maintain, enhance, and modernize backend services developed using Java and Spring Boot.   

 Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot software using JavaScript and other programming languages and technologies as required by the product.   

 Work with Oracle databases and SQL to develop, troubleshoot, optimize, and support application data and database interactions.   

 Learn and apply additional programming languages, frameworks, tools, and technologies as required by evolving application and mission needs.   

 Update software requirements, libraries, frameworks, and dependencies to ensure applications remain secure, supported, and maintainable.   

 Analyze and implement code changes resulting from dependency, framework, and technology upgrades.   

 Perform application maintenance activities, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, issue identification, and defect resolution.   

 Design and implement code enhancements and technical improvements based on customer, program, and operational requirements.   

 Collaborate with customers, software developers, systems engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver timely and effective solutions.   

 Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, technical discussions, and continuous improvement activities.   

 Support application deployments, troubleshooting, and operational activities within Linux and Docker-based environments.   

 Contribute to the long-term stability, reliability, security, performance, and modernization of mission-critical enterprise applications.   

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 TS/SCI with Polygraph     

 A bachelor’s degree and six (6) years of experience in software development/ engineering in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity. Ten (10) years of software development experience may be substituted in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.     

 Experience with Java development.    

 Experience working with Oracle databases, including SQL development.   

 Experience with a JavaScript framework such as Angular.    

 Experience developing in the Linux operating system.    

 Experience with Docker for containerized application deployment and management.    

 Must be able to work between the core hours of 10AM-2PM. Exceptions will be considered on a case-by-case basis.   

 
 Technology Stack of application(s) with which this role will interact: 

 
 Java  

 AWS  

 MySQL  

 Linux  

 Maven  

 SpringBoot  

 Docker  

 Angular  

 Git  

 GitLab  

 Atlassian Tool Suite 

 Oracle 

 Node.JS 

 Maven  

 
 The estimated salary range for this position is between $150,000-$200,000 (annualized USD). This range reflects the typical pay for the role and is one part of the company's comprehensive compensation package. Actual salaries are influenced by several factors, such as location, the individual’s education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract affordability and organizational needs. 
  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
